element.definition:
The container contains structured information about the procedure.

* Proposed temporary name / identifier
    * Procedure Detail – Medical Device (temporary container within the Procedure Generic Building Block).

* Concept description
    * This container contains information about medical devices that are used during a procedure or are the target of the procedure, such as implants, prostheses, or diagnostic devices.

* Source and rationale
    * Based on the openEHR Procedure model ( *Procedure Detail* ), zib Procedure (2024), and XTEHR Procedure (v0.2.1). Included to support the recording of medical devices in the context of procedures.

* Relationship between the current and future GB
    * This container records the medical devices associated with the procedure. It is a temporary solution and will be replaced by a reference to the future Medical Device Generic Building Block.

* Functional and semantic requirements
    * The future Generic Building Block shall support the identification of one or more medical devices, both as the target of a procedure and as devices used during the procedure.

* Status
    * Temporary reference to a Generic Building Block that has not yet been developed.

element.definition:
The container contains structured information about the procedure.

* Proposed temporary name / identifier
    * Procedure Detail – Medical Device (temporary container within the Procedure Generic Building Block).

* Concept description
    * This container contains information about medical devices that are used during a procedure or are the target of the procedure, such as implants, prostheses, or diagnostic devices.

* Source and rationale
    * Based on the openEHR Procedure model ( *Procedure Detail* ), zib Procedure (2024), and XTEHR Procedure (v0.2.1). Included to support the recording of medical devices in the context of procedures.

* Relationship between the current and future GB
    * This container records the medical devices associated with the procedure. It is a temporary solution and will be replaced by a reference to the future Medical Device Generic Building Block.

* Functional and semantic requirements
    * The future Generic Building Block shall support the identification of one or more medical devices, both as the target of a procedure and as devices used during the procedure.

* Status
    * Temporary reference to a Generic Building Block that has not yet been developed.
